outputs.explanation: Panel A shows super-resolution micrographs (localizations, density maps, 3D reconstructions, cluster segmentation), not a plot of averaged data.
Panel B shows super-resolution micrographs (localizations, density maps, 3D reconstructions, cluster segmentation), not a plot of averaged data.
Number of clusters/cell is shown as a scatter/dot plot with mean ± SEM overlaid on individual gray dots representing each cell, as stated in the caption.
Cluster sizes are shown as a scatter/dot plot with mean ± SEM overlaid on individual gray dots representing each cluster, as stated in the caption.
Proportion of clustered molecules per cell is shown as a scatter/dot plot with mean ± SEM overlaid on individual gray dots representing each cell, as stated in the caption.
Panel F shows representative micrographs of localizations and trajectories, not a plot of averaged data.

Top is a histogram of diffusion coefficients and bottom is a line plot of mean square displacement per trajectory; both plot types are exempt from requiring overlaid individual points (histograms and line plots), and the MSD plot already shows individual trajectory lines.
Panel H shows trajectory maps and a kymograph (micrograph-type visualizations), not a plot of averaged summary data.
